scope: 38 archived ticker/day contexts, 1-session point visits only; no new labels
bin_convention: lower-inclusive upper-exclusive; null upper means infinity
matching: within same symbol and decision date; remove identical levels first; maximum cardinality then minimum total absolute distance difference; no reuse; tie break by index; no outcomes in matching
identity: round(level,6), same as existing candidate inventory
stratified_standardization: same symbol/day/bin cells with both arms; weight=min(candidate counts); compute within-cell mean touch difference; report unmatched cells
unchanged_controls: identical levels retained separately, never called incremental observations
additional_constraints: No changed binning/caliper/selection after results. Both arms are point coordinates, no width/fill/profit interpretation. No p-values or independent-trial confidence intervals.
